reviewItem.question: For "[BUGFIX] Fix duplicate kubelet targets for nodes reporting several addresses of the same IP family", which environments are exposed? Confirm or correct the exposure condition.

exposure.needed: whether cluster nodes report several addresses of the same IP family at runtime

proposed.statement: The prometheus-operator bundled in kube-prometheus-stack 90.0.0 (operator v0.93.1) no longer creates duplicate kubelet targets for nodes that report several addresses of the same IP family.
